kind: Yabause isolated SH2 interpreter flat-RAM model, not Saturn timing

verified.entries: every tick of every script: the step's return and all 99 words of the SH-2 body against the host build of the same source; every probe: sh2z_vd_locate's result and all probe words, then sh2z_vd_lap_distance's result and all probe words, against the host

straight.description: ACCEL held for 600 ticks from the start line

steer_boost.description: 900 ticks: ACCEL, a boost every 240 ticks, LEAN_L in bursts, the stick swept -40 / 0 / +40

wall.description: 400 ticks: ACCEL, full right stick for ticks 120-135 into the right-hand wall and on

airborne.description: 300 ticks: ACCEL from 300 units above the road, falling back onto it

race.description: a line-holding driver for three laps (plate, recharge strip, mine, ramp, finish)

step2Verified.entries: every tick of every tube script: sh2z_vd_step2's return and all 99 words of the SH-2 body against the host build of the same source; on the road script the host step2 body must also equal sh2z_vd_step's

road.description: walled stadium, 600 ticks: ACCEL, a boost every 300 ticks, LEAN_R in bursts, the stick swept -50 / 0 / +50 (sh2z_vd_step's bits, checked on the host too)

pipe_bottom.description: pipe on spans 0-3, 240 ticks of ACCEL on its floor

pipe_wall.description: pipe on spans 0-3, 240 ticks of ACCEL on its left wall

pipe_ceiling.description: pipe on spans 0-3, 240 ticks of ACCEL on its ceiling

cylinder_top.description: cylinder on spans 0-3, 240 ticks of ACCEL on its top

cylinder_side.description: cylinder on spans 0-3, 240 ticks of ACCEL on its side

cylinder_bottom.description: cylinder on spans 0-3, 240 ticks of ACCEL underneath

pipe_join.description: pipe on spans 1-2 joining road at both ends (joins over 30% of each span), 400 ticks of ACCEL from the road into the pipe and out

label: MODELLED: executed SH-2 instructions in the Yabause interpreter; flat RAM, no caches or wait states; not Saturn hardware
